title: GAINER: Gain-Aware Allocation of Transformer Depth for Efficient Cross-Encoder Re-Ranking (code and results)
description:
Code and registered runs of the paper GAINER: Gain-Aware Allocation of Transformer Depth for Efficient Cross-Encoder Re-Ranking (I. Mohd Jamadi and S. Anuar, preprint, 2026; submitted to the International Journal of Advanced Computer Science and Applications).

The two Google Colab notebooks run the leave-one-dataset-out evaluation on seven BEIR datasets with two cross-encoder backbones and five seeds: the main registered run (hypotheses H1–H3, pre-registration SHA-256 e77241073ba22c17b36151adcffacaf3e7f47ff36b3fd38cbebae413026b4746) and the second registered family on value-of-computation allocation (H4–H6, SHA-256 1f4050281d4dbf8a27543aa6672f7295ea86880db50d1aecea2818ec52ef11b1). Both are saved with the outputs of their registered runs. No dataset is redistributed.
